observation.command:
cat > /workspace/.patch_nginx.py <<'PYEOF'
p = '/workspace/deployment/docker-compose.dev.yml'
s = open(p).read()
old = """  nginx:
    image: nginx:stable-alpine
    container_name: qonnectra_nginx_dev
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./nginx/default.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
"""
new = """  nginx:
    image: nginx:stable-alpine
    container_name: qonnectra_nginx_dev
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./nginx/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
      - ./nginx/default.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
"""
assert s.count(old) == 1, s.count(old)
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print("nginx volumes patched")
PYEOF
docker run --rm -v /workspace:/workspace qonnectra/backend:dev python3 /workspace/.patch_nginx.py; rm /workspace/.patch_nginx.py
cd /workspace/deployment && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml config --quiet && echo "CONFIG OK" && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d nginx 2>&1 | tail -4
